description: This file defines the UserOOOService class, which manages out-of-office (OOO) entries, including validation, creation, updating, deletion, and retrieval with pagination. It interacts with repositories and handles business logic related to out-of-office scheduling.

classes.name: UserOOOService
classes.description: Service class handling out-of-office (OOO) entries, including validation, creation, update, deletion, and retrieval with pagination.

methods.name: formatOooReason
methods.description: Formats an OutOfOfficeEntry object to include a human-readable reason based on reasonId.

methods.name: isStartBeforeEnd
methods.description: Validates that the start date is before the end date; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: checkUserEligibleForRedirect
methods.description: Checks if a user is eligible for redirect to another user.

methods.name: checkExistingOooRedirect
methods.description: Checks for existing redirect bookings to prevent infinite redirect loops.

methods.name: checkDuplicateOOOEntry
methods.description: Checks for duplicate OOO entries within the same time frame.

methods.name: checkIsValidOOO
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation for creating or updating an OOO entry.

methods.name: createUserOOO
methods.description: Creates a new out-of-office entry after validation.

methods.name: updateUserOOO
methods.description: Updates an existing out-of-office entry after validation.

methods.name: getUserOOOPaginated
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of OOO entries, formatted with reasons.
